description: Havoc Demon Hunter-style melee - weaves Energy fillers with mana-draining Starsunder/Astral Blade bursts. Aspect of the Warden layers a bonus-attack proc, Shadowsong's Mandate chains crits into Warden's Blade.
_source_note: Built from CoA handoff doc + confirmed screenshot numbers (Warden's Blade, Fan of Knives, Umbral Blade confirmed via screenshot). Real mechanic per handoff: Starsunder and Astral Blade each drain a large chunk of max mana as their real cost/power source (mana-scaled burst), reclaimed through Celestial Strike, Aspect of the Warden's proc layer, and Rally the Sentinels.

nodes.name: Maiev's Discipline
nodes.description: Grants critical strike rating and expertise from Intellect at 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: 'Level 20 Passive. Crit rating + expertise from Intellect.'

nodes.name: Deadly Precision
nodes.description: Increases Attack Power by 3% per rank.

nodes.name: Swift Glaives
nodes.description: Increases Haste by 1% per rank.

nodes.name: Arcane Focus
nodes.description: Increases maximum Mana by 2% per rank.

nodes.name: Celestial Glaives
nodes.description: Sentinel Glaive, Astral Blade, Umbral Blade and Fan of Knives scatter stars across the target, reducing its Armor by 12 per stack. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 4 turns.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: 'Level 30 Passive. Allows extra Scattered Star stacking.'

nodes.name: Vigil of the Watchers
nodes.description: Learn Vigil of the Watchers, a party and raid critical strike chance buff. Does not stack with similar effects.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Party/raid crit chance buff (no stacking with similar).' Called out as real raid-wide value alongside Halt/Bonds of Justice.

nodes.name: Warden Training
nodes.description: Starsunder critical strikes scatter another star, adding a stack of Scattered Stars to the target for 4 turns.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Starsunder crits apply an extra Scattered Star stack.'

nodes.name: Magic Mark
nodes.description: Astral Blade brands the target with a Magic Mark, searing it for 45 Arcane damage each turn for 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: 'Level 40 Passive. Scattered Stars boost target's Arcane damage taken per stack.'

nodes.name: Sentinel Glaive
nodes.description: Learn Sentinel Glaive, a thrown weapon dealing Arcane damage that scales with maximum mana and increases the target's resource costs.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Thrown weapon + Arcane damage, scales with max mana; boosts target's resource costs.' Real gap-closer/poke tool.

nodes.name: Astral Blade
nodes.description: Learn Astral Blade, dealing Arcane damage that scales with maximum mana and increases the target's damage taken from you.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as Warden's real mana-scaled burst button: 'Arcane damage, scales with max mana; boosts target's damage taken from you.'

nodes.name: Shadowsong's Mandate
nodes.description: Your critical strikes have a 25% chance to swing a free Warden's Blade at the target, no more than once per turn.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as this spec's real burst-window mechanic: 'Boosts crit chance + movement speed; damaging crits chance to trigger Warden's Blade.'

nodes.name: Rally The Sentinels
nodes.description: Sentinel Glaive has a 20% chance per rank to rally the Watchers, restoring 60 Mana.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Sentinel Glaive restores mana + applies a Scattered Star.' A key mana-sustain lever for this spec's heavy Astral Blade/Starsunder drains.

nodes.name: Bonds of Justice
nodes.description: Learn Bonds of Justice, tethering an enemy. When the tether breaks, they are gripped back to you with Arcane damage.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as a real group-value control tool: 'Tethers an enemy; break (expiry or 10+ yds distance) grips them back with Arcane damage.'

nodes.name: Halt
nodes.description: Learn Halt, interrupting and school-locking an enemy's current cast.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as Warden's real interrupt: 'Interrupts + school-locks an enemy's current cast.' Handoff describes it as a teleport-and-silence, real AoE-lockout when landed on a cluster.

nodes.name: Shooting Star
nodes.description: Learn Shooting Star, a burst of movement speed. Cannot be slowed and cannot stop moving while active.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Movement speed burst; can't be slowed, can't stop moving while active.' The spec's only real defensive/disengage tool.

nodes.name: Avatar of Vengeance
nodes.description: Transform, teleporting to your target and increasing your Intellect. Extends Astral Blade's range and makes it teleport you to the target for the duration.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as Warden's real capstone transform, analogous to Metamorphosis per the retail comparison: 'Transform: teleports to target, boosts Intellect; extends Astral Blade's range + makes it teleport you to target for the duration.'

nodes.name: Infused Blades
nodes.description: Astral Blade has a 10% chance per rank to refund its full Mana cost.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Astral Blade on cooldown (Infused Blades can reset/refund it).' Real burst-sustain lever mentioned throughout the rotation writeup.

nodes.name: Stellar Amplification
nodes.description: Your critical strikes have an 8% chance per rank to gather the stars around you, increasing damage dealt by 4% for 2 turns. Stacks up to 3 times.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Scattered Star damage chance to free the next Astral Blade.'

nodes.name: Vigil of the Moon
nodes.description: Learn Vigil of the Moon, revealing stealthed and invisible enemies in an area.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Reveals stealthed/invisible enemies in an area.'

nodes.name: Reckless Glaives
nodes.description: Increases Sentinel Glaive and Astral Blade damage by 4% per rank.

nodes.name: Precision of the Watchers
nodes.description: Increases critical strike damage by 4% per rank.

nodes.name: Unwavering Focus
nodes.description: Reduces the Mana cost of Astral Blade and Starsunder by 2% per rank.
